accepted.quote: The single most effective action that can be taken to help the OIG recover funds is to ensure that they have adequate funding.
accepted.rationale: Velazquez argues the SBA OIG needs sufficient funding to pursue fraud investigations and recoveries.

accepted.quote: While the ``Put America on Commission Act 2026'' would establish a mechanism to report fraud to SBA, there are already ways for individuals to report potential fraud.
accepted.bill: H.R. 7129 Put America on Commission Act 2026
accepted.rationale: Velazquez suggests the bill's new fraud-reporting mechanism is duplicative of existing OIG and other reporting channels.
